classification.difficultyReason: Median from stem-and-leaf plots with 12 and 15 values. It needs a position calculation, with an average of two values in part a. This is the same skill as slot 1.

content.prompt: Find the median of these stem-and-leaf plots. $1\mid 5$ means $15$.

answer.worked:
There are $12$ scores.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{12+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=6.5\end{align*}$$
The median is between the $6^{\mathrm{th}}$ and $7^{\mathrm{th}}$ scores, $13$ and $17$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{13+17}{2}\\\text{Median}&=15\end{align*}$$

There are $15$ scores.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{15+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=8\end{align*}$$
The $8^{\mathrm{th}}$ score is $53$, so the median is $53$.
